description: Java class representing an OrderAccount entity in the sales management system, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping, including relations to Order and OrderAccountProduct entities, and utility methods for property access and cloning.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: Entity class for order account details, including start/end dates and associated products.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the order account.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order account.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an Order object with this order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date for the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the order account, cloning the provided date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date for the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the order account, cloning the provided date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Returns the billing day of the month for the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Sets the billing day of the month for the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of associated OrderAccountProduct entities.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Sets the set of OrderAccountProduct entities associated with this account.
